seo.title: Privacy Notice
seo.description: Privacy notice of Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC) governing the use of certificacionmontessori.com.

intro.p1: <blanco>At Asociación Montessori de México A.C., </blanco>we protect the personal data you provide and explain here how we process it.

responsable.p1: Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC), a private civil association, is the controller of personal data. Its address is Avenida Dos 48, San Pedro de los Pinos, Benito Juárez, 03800 Ciudad de México, CDMX, México.

fundamento.titulo: Legal basis for processing personal data
fundamento.p1: This notice is governed by the Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (Mexico's federal law on personal data held by private parties), published in the DOF on 20-03-2025 and last reformed on 14-11-2025, and other provisions applicable to private controllers.

recopilamos.p1: When you request information, enroll, make a payment, or contact us, we may process the data you provide, such as your name, email address, telephone number, message, postal address, and necessary academic or administrative data. Stripe processes payment-method data; AMMAC does not store full card numbers. Optional analytics is described separately.

uso.p1: Required purposes are responding to requests and contact, managing enrollment and programs, processing and reconciling payments, delivering publications or services, maintaining records, providing support, and meeting legal obligations. These operations do not depend on allowing analytics. Promotional communications and Google Analytics are optional purposes and require the applicable consent.

analytics.p1: Google Analytics (GA4, measurement G-P0CNEGW276) loads only when you choose Allow analytics. Google acts as the provider and may process technical and usage information such as pages visited, date and time, browser, device, referrer, and approximate location.
analytics.p2: Your choice is stored in browser local storage under ammac-analytics-consent-v1. You may decline, revoke, or allow it again at any time through Privacy preferences in the site footer. Declining or revoking does not limit programs, forms, payments, or contact. Revocation blocks later events and attempts to remove first-party GA cookies, but it is not retroactive regarding processing already performed.
analytics.exclusiones: AMMAC does not send names, email addresses, telephone numbers, messages, postal addresses, order identifiers, or access tokens to GA4.

compartimos.p1: We may share strictly necessary data with providers acting for AMMAC, such as Stripe for payments and Google for analytics only after consent, and with authorities when legally required.
compartimos.nota: Providers must process data for specific purposes and under applicable privacy and security measures.
compartimos.p2: We do not sell personal data. Any additional transfer will follow applicable law and, where required, the corresponding consent.

modificaciones.p1: Changes or updates to this notice will be published at this same URL: https://certificacionmontessori.com/en/privacy/. The visible last-updated date identifies the current version.

arco.p1: You may request access, rectification, cancellation, or objection (ARCO rights), revoke consent, or limit use of your data by sending your request to admin@certificacionmontessori.com or filing it at Avenida Dos 48, San Pedro de los Pinos, Benito Juárez, 03800 Ciudad de México, CDMX, México. State your name and a contact method, documents proving identity or representation when applicable, a clear description of the right you wish to exercise, and data or details that help locate the information. For rectification, identify the requested changes and attach supporting documentation. AMMAC will communicate its decision within no more than 20 days after receipt and, if granted, will implement it within the following 15 days. Each period may be extended once for an equal period when justified.

seo.title: Refund Policy
seo.description: Conditions for requesting refunds on enrollment fees, tuition, books, and training materials at the Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC).

intro.p1: The Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC) offers online payments for enrollment fees, tuition, books, and training materials. The conditions under which refunds may be requested are described below.

s1.titulo: 1. Enrollment in diploma courses and training programs
s1.p1: If you request a refund within 5 calendar days of payment and before the program's start date, 100% of the amount paid as an enrollment fee is refunded. After that period, the enrollment fee is non-refundable, but it may be transferred to a future cohort, subject to availability and to the decision of the academic coordination office.

s2.p1: Monthly tuition is charged in advance for the current period. Once the corresponding month has begun, tuition is non-refundable. Recurring subscriptions can be canceled at any time from the student portal; cancellation prevents future charges but does not generate a refund for the current month.

s3.p1: Physical books may be returned within 7 calendar days of receiving the product, provided it is in its original condition (unused, unmarked, and in its original packaging). Return shipping costs are borne by the buyer, except in cases of a damaged product or a shipping error attributable to AMMAC.
s3.p2: Ebooks and downloadable digital materials are non-refundable once the download has been completed, given their intangible and immediate nature.

s4.p1: If you detect a duplicate charge or a technical error that resulted in an incorrect charge, write to us as soon as possible. These cases are resolved with a full refund within no more than 5 business days from confirmation of the error.

s5.titulo: 5. How do I request a refund?
lista: Full name of the student or buyer.
Order number or payment reference (you will find it in your Stripe confirmation email or in your records on the student portal).
s5.p2: You can also contact us on WhatsApp at <linkWhatsapp>55 4888 5013</linkWhatsapp> from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (Mexico City time), or by phone at <linkTelefono>55 5515 2701</linkTelefono>.

s6.p1: Once a refund is approved, the amount is returned to the original payment method. For credit or debit cards, the time it takes to appear on the customer's statement depends on the issuing bank and may range from 5 to 15 business days. AMMAC processes the refund immediately through Stripe; crediting times are determined by the bank.

s7.p1: Online payments are processed by Stripe Payments Mexico in compliance with PCI-DSS data security standards. AMMAC does not store card information in its systems.

s8.p1: This policy may be updated at any time. Changes are published on this same page. The date of the last update appears at the bottom of this document.
